description: List open GoTokenMe tasks on published campaigns. Public, read-only. Filter optionally by campaign_id, task_type, or limit (1-50).

campaign_id.description: Optional published campaign ID to filter tasks.

limit.description: Maximum number of open tasks to return (1-50, default 20).

task_type.description: Optional task type (e.g. research, coding, writing, design).

name: list_open_tasks
title: List open tasks
